This bidang usaha is allocated to Koperasi and UMKM under Perpres 49/2021's Lampiran II (p.6, entry 23 "Industri alat musik tradisional"), so a PT PMA cannot register it. The steps below are the Koperasi/UMKM registration route, not a PMA one.
1. **NIB via OSS** — register on oss.go.id as a Koperasi/UMKM entity, select this code, issued automatically (1–3 days)
2. **Submit industrial data report every 6 months (Kemenperin)** — post-license obligation
3. **Menjamin keamanan dan keselamatan alat, proses, hasil produksi, penyimpan-an, serta pengangkutan, se...** — post-license obligation
